parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region to which the associated Server Load Balancer (SLB) instance belongs.

parameters.name: VServerGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the VServer group to be deleted.

>  If the VServer group is in use, it cannot be deleted.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun slb delete-vserver-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vserver-group-id rsp-cige6j00000 --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
